title: The Guilty
description: Every mob you kill now makes you guilty
body:
# Ever felt nothing when slaying mobs?
This mod fixes that.

In-game, a kill sound will play whenever a mob dies.

![In-game, a kill sound will play whenever a mob dies.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9e0fddddadddcbf6ef8d83d8d0d6c27fe8836d3.gif)

**Features:**

- Over 10 unique guilt messages (dark, philosophical, and humorous)
- Randomized lines so you never know what you’ll get
- Sound effects to enhance the atmosphere
- You can adjust the volume under Music & Sounds → Friendly Creatures.
- Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer

This mod doesn’t add items, blocks, or mechanics—just emotional damage.

This mod hasn't been fully tested in multiplayer, feedback is appreciated!

**Modpacks**

Feel free to include The GUilty in modpacks.
